review_description: Note - 3 phase system so I thought I was going more to the quality end of suppliers.

I got several quotes and did a lot of research before deciding on an installer.  These guys were really helpful and responsive to my many questions and I think their suggestions of a system really matched my requirements.  After the quote the site inspection identified everything required for install and no additional charger occurred.  The install happened quickly after I paid the deposit and a day after the stock landed it was installed.  I really wanted to make the most of the 2025 rebates and not loose due to getting it installed the following year.  I was a bit unclear of the procedure post installation and think a pdf listing the process would help other future clients.

From initial contact the process was easy, friendly and professional.  quick quote offering alternatives and good pricing for a quality system.  After selection, a quick on-site inspection to confirm and explain location of the battery.  Required deposit was lower than expected and I was advised that the battery could be expected at the end of the month.Contacted by the office staff to complete all the paperwork for the installation and rebate.  Easy!Installation was quicker than expected and the tradesmen turned up exactly as planned and completed a very professional installation and arranged for the electrical inspector to visit next day.Battery is now charging.

The quoting stage was very well handled and clarified some of my misconceptions giving me confidence to move ahead. The installation was right on time but challenged by weather leaving a couple of aspects that I was not completely satisfied with. Customer service follow up on that though was enthusiastic, timely and the minor rectifications completed without delay and as requested.Everything was pretty well explained and the software interface is so easy to monitor all aspects that it has been a joy to start to generate and store electricity.

We are thrilled to have our solar panels up and working with 3 weeks of asking for quotes. We wanted a quality system. We used Solar+Electrical who inspected our roof, before quoting.  This gave us peace of mind, especially as they found a dip in our roof which led to a slightly different panel configuration.  Jess helped with options, clear explanations and with the rebate process. She kept us informed, Alvin managed the communication with the power companies and Michael arrived on time and oversaw the installation from start to finish.  They have quite a team!  4 installers on the day plus the electrician.  Customer service was excellent.  I highly recommend Solar+Electrical for anyone in Melbourne looking to start their solar journey.

Their upstream supplier for Batteries (Esy) stuffed the installation process (batteries were supposed to come in to stock week before, then moved, then confirmed, then were still not delivered on the day) so install had to be done in a couple of parts, but the guys themselves were good - so the 3 star is not 100% reflective of SolarPlus, but then maybe they haven't managed Esy as well as they could have, I don't know. Just my experience for this install and I did have to organise to be at home multiple days, if there hadn't been the issue with that delivery the experience would have been different.The salesperson was quite enthusiastic, and adjusted the quote when the budget started to push out, with what is probably a better total package anyway, while technically lower quality battery was 50% bigger than the initial option and $5000 cheaper, so make sure you discuss the options.

Solar+ installation went very well.  Communications and customer service levels were excellent throughout.  Michael, the lead installer, was also excellent and was happy to take time to explain the system, how it would be installed and how it would integrate with my existing solar panels and inverters.  I was impressed with Michael’s knowledgeable approach to the job

We used Solar Plus for our installation. Fantastic!They responded to our request for a quote within 24 hrs. Our roof configuration is unusual with major shade areas from large trees. We explained what we wanted(solar plus battery).Electrician came to our house and got up on roof to measure exactly where and how many panels we could fit, and how shade would affect it. We then received 2 options within a few days.We agreed to the proposal and were given an installation date for two weeks later.Installers arrived on time, and did a great job. Installation went smoothly. All staff were courteous and polite and explained each step of the install. Site clean up after was excellent.System is working to our expectations and exactly as promised. Solar plus did everything they said they would do, exactly when they said they would do it.I would rate them 12/10. Professional, efficient, courteous and knowledgeable. Can’t rate them highly enough.

In the first instance, Michael from Solar Plus Electrical was the only Company who wanted to come out and check our premises without being asked.  We received a phone call from Jess (Office Manager) who stated that Michael wanted to first check our roof, switch board, fuse box, wiring etc. to make sure what they were going to quote, could be achieved.  Very impressive!Jess was so polite and answered my endless questions and redid quotes for alternative sized systems without hesitation.Michael (owner and electrician) was punctual, efficient and a great person to deal with.Post installation, Solar Plus Electrical liaised with the Utility companies and trouble shot where necessary.I have no reservations about recommending this Company for all your solar needs.
